, a blood elf leatherworker.]] Leatherworkers are artisans who take the rough, spiny or sturdy hides of beasts everywhere and turn them into useful products. First and foremost among these creations are lighter armors - leather and mail - as well as cloaks, bags, and unique patches and stitching that improve the defensive values of armor. They rely on skinners to gather skins and other materials from beasts.

The Legacy System is the -specific implementation of achievements. Available after reaching level 25 on at least one character and accessed via the default keybind or the Legacy button in the micro menu, Legacy improves the leveling experience for alts and professions. The Legacy interface is divided into three sections: Rewards, Challenges, and Trees.
This is the list of available challenges from the Legacy System. Each challenge rewards 1 Legacy Point that can be used on the Legacy Tree.

Legibly Scribbled Notes are created by Khaz Algar engineers by disassembling inventions made with Scour Through Scrap. Like Hastily Scrawled Notes, combining 15 creates Comprehensibly Organized Ideas. However, these differ from the latter in that they can only be created when all recipes are learned from the Comprehensibly Organized Ideas. Being Warbound, their only purpose is to teach an alt character in your Warband Khaz Algar Engineering recipes.

__NOTOC__ The Legion Dungeon was a test dungeon that shipped with , but was never accessible through normal means. The assets used are largely a mix of both demon and draenei aesthetics seen in Talador and Tanaan Jungle. It consists of a singular curving path through a draenei ruin flooded with fel lava. Distinct boss areas can be seen. Given the similarities between the two, it may have been used in developing what would eventually become Eredath in patch 7.3.0, with the Auchindoun copy being used as a placeholder for the Seat of the Triumvirate.
